title: OM day one: ₹17.7 crore net in India (Sacnilk), Dhanush's career-best opening; ₹31.55 crore worldwide
headline: OM Opens to ₹17.7 Crore, Dhanush's Biggest Day One, Trackers Say
caption:
Dhanush's spy thriller OM made an estimated ₹17.7 crore net in Indian cinemas on Friday, 20 November, trade tracker Sacnilk says. That is the biggest opening day of his career, ahead of Tere Ishk Mein's roughly ₹16 crore.

Worldwide, OM grossed an estimated ₹31.55 crore on day one, about ₹11 crore of it overseas. The Tamil version brought in ₹13.35 crore net, the Telugu version ₹4 crore and the Hindi version ₹35 lakh.

Rajkumar Periasamy's film also stars Mammootty and Sai Pallavi. These are tracker estimates; the makers haven't announced a figure.

Sources: Sacnilk, The Hollywood Reporter India, DNA, Filmibeat
